authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: A Lean formalization of topological semantics for endpoint-varying computational paths. It constructs both the canonical final composable quotient and the ordinary pullback of quotient arrows. The selected result proves that the canonical comparison is a continuous bijection and characterizes exactly when it is quotient, a homeomorphism, and an induced topology agreement; under these equivalent conditions ordinary composition is continuous.
